find_fragments.description: Find the passages the library's editors have indexed under a theme (love, death, betrayal, the passing of time) and, optionally, narrowed to one author, epoch, kind or genre. This index is hand-made and goes down to the passage, so it answers 'what does Polish Romanticism say about the homeland' rather than 'which books mention it'. At least one filter is required. A listing names each passage; turn on 'Include the text' to fetch the words too. Wolne Lektury serves this listing whole, so a broad theme is cut to the number of results you ask for and 'total_count' reports how many there were.

fragments.text: Czegoż chcesz, duszo? Zabawy czy tańca?

find_fragments.name: find_fragments

parameters.description: Only passages indexed under this theme, given as a slug such as 'zabawa' (fun) or 'milosc' (love). List tags for 'theme' returns every slug the library accepts.
parameters.name: theme

parameters.description: Only works by this author, given as a slug such as 'adam-mickiewicz'. List tags for 'author' returns every slug the library accepts.

parameters.description: Only works from this literary epoch, given as a slug. List tags for 'epoch' returns every slug the library accepts.
parameters.name: epoch

parameters.description: Only works of this genre, given as a slug. List tags for 'genre' returns every slug the library accepts.

parameters.description: How many passages to return, from 1 to 500. Defaults to 50. Wolne Lektury serves this listing in one piece with no page size of its own, so a broad theme sends every passage carrying it; 'total_count' says how many it sent.

parameters.description: Fetch each passage's words as well as its address. The listing itself does not carry them, so this costs one extra request per passage. Off by default.

parameters.description: With 'Include the text' on, how many passages to fetch the words for, from 1 to 25. Defaults to 10. The rest are still listed, just without their text.
parameters.name: max_texts

list_tags.description: List the library's authors, literary epochs, kinds, genres or themes, each with the slug every other action's filters take. This is where those slugs come from: the library's vocabularies are curated by its editors, so nothing else can be relied on to spell them. Terms come back in slug order, so a large vocabulary can be walked a page at a time with 'Continue after'.

search_books.description: Search the Wolne Lektury catalogue by title and by author. Words match from the start of a word, so 'pan' finds 'Pan Tadeusz'; works whose author matched are returned before works whose title did. Every filter is optional and they combine: narrow to an author, an epoch, a kind or a genre, to works that have an audiobook, or to the ones Polish schools set as required reading.
search_books.name: search_books

parameters.description: Text to match against titles and author names, at least three characters long. Leave empty to browse with the filters alone.
parameters.name: search

description: Read Wolne Lektury, the free digital library of Polish literature: several thousand works, most of them school set texts, each with an ebook in every common format and often a human-read audiobook. Search by title or author, browse by epoch, kind or genre, pull a work's full text or download links into a workflow, and search the library's hand-made index of literary themes down to the individual passage. No account or API key is required.
